payload.authority: Advisor decision, 2026-08-30, recorded by the maintainer. The thesis is the deliverable and a protected final test is the appropriate standard for it. This amendment is written and frozen while heldout_access_count is 0, which is the only thing that makes the protected-final-test claim checkable.

amendment_frequency.after: New amendments and new audit layers are opened only when (a) the FORMAL_E1_FINAL partition is accidentally accessed, (b) scientific semantics materially change, or (c) the pipeline cannot execute. Ordinary implementation work proceeds without a new record.
amendment_frequency.before: Every change of judgement criteria requires a new amendment record.
amendment_frequency.why: The governance layer has begun to cost more than the evidence it protects. The remaining work is to finish E1.

heldout_access_count_semantics.after: split_registry.heldout_access_count counts reads of FORMAL_E1_FINAL only and must be 0 until the final evaluation. E1_DEVELOPMENT_PROBE reads are recorded in the separate append-only ledger data/splits/heldout_probe_access_ledger.json with their own counter.
heldout_access_count_semantics.before: split_registry.heldout_access_count counts reads of any heldout_real value and must be 0 until E1 final.
heldout_access_count_semantics.why: The existing guards in audit/firewall, audit/e1_gates and the calibration identity gate all key on heldout_access_count. Re-pointing it at the sealed subset keeps every one of those guards meaningful instead of making them fire on a sanctioned probe read. Mixing probe reads into that counter would destroy the only number that still means "the final test is untouched".

heldout_partition.after: heldout_real is split, BEFORE any value is read, into E1_DEVELOPMENT_PROBE (14/class = 56) and FORMAL_E1_FINAL (28/class = 112). Selection is a deterministic class-stratified permutation with fixed seed 20260830, one rng per class, frozen as HELDOUT-PART-001 in freeze/heldout_partition.lock.json. The freeze is refused unless heldout_access_count is 0 at that moment.
heldout_partition.before: heldout_real is a single 168-recording partition (42/class) whose access_count must remain 0 until E1 final. There is no sanctioned way to inspect any held-out value during method development.
heldout_partition.why: Freezing the ids first is the whole protection. If the subsets were chosen after seeing values, the final test set would be a selected one and its result would mean nothing.

not_terminal_but_still_terminal.after: NOT_CONVERGED and UNSTABLE_LANDSCAPE remain terminal and still stop the flow. Those two say the optimiser could not do its job at all, which is a different statement from "the answer it found should be rejected".
not_terminal_but_still_terminal.why: Inhibiting an update presupposes there is a well-formed update to inhibit. There is not one when the search never converged or when a fifth of the landscape could not be evaluated.

stage_guard_terminal_state.after: Either breach marks the stage UPDATE_INHIBITED. The proposed parameter update is REJECTED, the previous frozen (or initial) value is RETAINED, both guard measurements are recorded in full, and the run continues to the next stage. The tolerances, the seeds and the guard computations are unchanged; only the consequence changes.
stage_guard_terminal_state.before: optimizer.verification_seeds: relative degradation above verification_tolerance marks SEED_OVERFIT and stops the flow. reporting.regression_guard: a worsening of the non-optimised terms above regression_tolerance marks SIDE_EFFECT_REGRESSION and stops the flow.
stage_guard_terminal_state.claim_boundary: UPDATE_INHIBITED is a FUNCTIONALLY INSPIRED name: a proposed state change is suppressed when independent evidence indicates the update harms system-level stability. It is an engineering control rule and nothing more. It does NOT model, demonstrate or provide evidence for any biological neural inhibition mechanism, and no claim of that kind may be made from it anywhere in the thesis.
stage_guard_terminal_state.why: A failed proposal is evidence that this parameter should not move, not evidence that the remaining stages are unsound. Retaining the frozen initial value is the minimum-displacement outcome the tie-break rule already prefers when the data cannot distinguish candidates.

invariants_preserved.bounds_unchanged: initial_simulation.lock parameter_ranges and the derived feasible domains are untouched; bounds_resolution_hash stays de9ce5a2f009e08afc916208f6dd9ee4880a84bed0919dd5d9fb290f1dea9aeb.
invariants_preserved.budget_unchanged: popsize 15, maxiter 100, restarts 3 and the per-stage evaluation budgets are unchanged. Inhibiting an update does not reduce the search that produced it.
invariants_preserved.calibration_data_unchanged: raw_calibration_data_hash stays 926eef729eb3b5b4762fe7a77c139f5ca89375a57367de432508dfa8a8ca1ed8 and is re-asserted on every load.
invariants_preserved.formal_e1_final_sealed: FORMAL_E1_FINAL is not read by this amendment, by the partition freeze, or by any calibration stage. heldout_access_count remains 0 until the calibrated simulator and all gate rules are frozen.
invariants_preserved.frozen_scale_unchanged: CAL-SF-001 (payload hash 8e71171c7ae851c1e575627a78ac107b626f7c228895125b07b864454ee0096e) is not recomputed. s_f stays exactly as frozen.
invariants_preserved.guard_authority_unchanged: verification_tolerance stays 0.10 and regression_tolerance stays 0.10. The guards still fire on exactly the same evidence; only the consequence of firing changed.
invariants_preserved.stage0_admission_unchanged: CAL-STAGE0-001 is not re-run and not re-adjudicated. The seven admitted parameters and the zero-dimensional SCENE_PARTICIPATING_MEDIA stage stand.

precondition_evidence.note: Both numbers above were measured BEFORE this amendment was written, by the runner at c1f6f9d, and are reproducible from outputs/calibration/stage_SCENE_GEOMETRY_SURFACE_FOIL/stage_summary.json. This amendment changes what happens next; it does not change, re-run or re-interpret that measurement.

payload.rationale:
The formal calibration run at code_version c1f6f9d converged cleanly in stage 1 (three restarts, spread 1.6e-4, zero failed evaluations) and then broke both preregistered guards at once: verification-seed degradation 8.26 against a tolerance of 0.10, and a 28.5% worsening of the non-optimised terms against a tolerance of 0.10. Under CAL-PREREG-003 that stopped the whole flow, leaving four stages unexecuted and no calibrated simulator.
The guards were right and must keep their authority. What was wrong was the consequence. A stage whose proposed update fails independent evidence does not invalidate the stages after it: stage 1's parameter simply should not move. Rejecting the update and holding sensor.fov_deg at its frozen initial value leaves the physical model exactly as the initial freeze left it, which is a defensible state, and lets the three mapping stages -- whose parameters are separately identifiable and whose channels are not the noisy one -- be fitted. Stopping instead produces no simulator at all, which is strictly worse and is not what the guards were protecting.
The governance change is the honest counterpart. This is a thesis, not a registered-report submission, and a design that cannot ever look at a development sample forces every method decision to be made blind and then defended by assertion. Splitting the held-out partition BEFORE reading any value keeps the property that actually matters -- the final test set is fixed in advance and never tuned against -- while allowing a small logged probe for sanity checking. The protection is the freezing order, not the refusal to look.
payload.supersedes: CAL-PREREG-003 (protocol hash 51796b777fda308f8aca6d60e99634faf258d1bd1720d729a23d972b5af8a807, frozen as record hash fb9638d78df974ca90f16546c9aa5367371fe2d82e8284190f5f6c8ad63b70fa) in two respects only: the terminal-state semantics of optimizer.verification_seeds and reporting.regression_guard, and the meaning of split.heldout_access_count. Every other clause of CAL-PREREG-003 stands unchanged, including the objective, the frozen s_f, the resolved bounds, the stage order, the evaluation budget and the convergence rule.
payload.title: Move the research governance from journal-grade blind preregistration to a thesis-oriented protected-final-test design: split the untouched held-out partition into a loggable development probe and a sealed final test before any value is read, and change a calibration stage guard breach from "stop the flow" to "inhibit the update, retain the previous value, continue".
